entities.name: MnmC
observations: 606 aa bifunctional tRNA-modification enzyme with an exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q5QUE0.
N-terminal region contains Methyltransf_30 domain PF05430 at residues 111–235; C-terminal region contains DAO-like FAD-dependent oxidoreductase domain PF01266 at residues 250–581.
Cytoplasmic enzyme catalyzing the final two steps of mnm5s2U34 biosynthesis.

entities.name: tRNA mnm5s2U34 formation
observations: Overall annotated reaction: cmnm5s2U34 in tRNA is demodified to nm5s2U34, then nm5s2U34 receives a methyl group from S-adenosyl-L-methionine to form mnm5s2U34 and S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.
Methyl-transfer component reaction: 5-aminomethyl-2-thiouridine(34) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 5-methylaminomethyl-2-thiouridine(34) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+).
Mapped to Rhea RHEA:19569 and related entries RHEA:10195 and RHEA:10197.

entities.name: FAD
observations: FAD is the required cofactor for the C-terminal cmnm5s2U34 oxidoreductase activity; ChEBI:CHEBI:57692.

entities.name: tRNA wobble base modification
observations: MnmC participates in the final two steps of 5-methylaminomethyl-2-thiouridine formation at tRNA wobble position U34.
Associated GO biological process includes tRNA wobble uridine modification.
